subject.title: feat(agents): add iteration budget for agent loop safety

question: Should OpenClaw accept `agents.defaults.iterationBudget` / `agents.list[].iterationBudget` plus `supportsIterationBudget` as the supported public loop-safety contract after this PR is rebased?
rationale: The code path is plausible and proven, but the PR creates durable config and harness API semantics that automation should not finalize without maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept after rebase
options.body: Resolve conflicts, keep the feature opt-in, and merge after confirming the names/defaults and fail-closed behavior are the intended contract.

options.title: Require API changes
options.body: Ask the branch to rename, narrow, or mark the config/hook experimental before making it a shipped public surface.

options.title: Pause direction
options.body: Hold or close the PR until the canonical iteration-limit issue settles on a different abstraction.

recommendation.title: Accept after rebase
recommendation.body: Resolve conflicts, keep the feature opt-in, and merge after confirming the names/defaults and fail-closed behavior are the intended contract.
